After years working in professional cleaning, Kirstyn started Karma’s Cleans to bring her own approach to caring for people’s spaces.

It’s the extra attention, the friendly conversation, and the little details that make a home feel like home again. Her team takes the time to understand what matters to you.

Whether you need a regular helping hand or a one-time refresh, it starts with a conversation.

A little clarity

Before we begin.

Can I book a one-time clean?

Yes. Karma’s Cleans offers one-time and recurring cleaning options. Discuss your preferred timing and the areas you’d like cleaned when requesting a quote.

How much will my clean cost?

Your quote should reflect the size and condition of the space, the service you choose, and your priorities. Kirstyn can confirm the scope and price before you book.

Can I request eco-friendly products?

Eco-friendly options are available upon request according to Karma’s Cleans’ current website. Mention any sensitivities or product preferences when you enquire.

What if I have a special request?

Add it to your quote request or speak with Kirstyn directly. The team can discuss what is possible and confirm the details with you.
